title: The Alon-Jaeger-Tarsi Conjecture in Dimensions Eight and Nine over F_5
decided_scope: All invertible 8x8 and 9x9 matrices over F_5 admit a nowhere-zero input vector with nowhere-zero image
open_boundaries: Dimensions n >= 10 over F_5 and prime fields 7 <= p <= 61, p = 79 in general dimension
